reference.label: Diffuse nuclear/RNA-processing genes
reference.evidence: Largest factor (9.3% usage, ~4860 effective genes) with uniformly low specificity (<0.5): DDX5, RBM33, HNRNPA2B1, KMT2C/D, BPTF, EP300, VPS13B/C. No lineage markers (CD3E, MS4A1, CD14, NKG7 all zero); a generic background of long chromatin/RNA-processing transcripts.

reference.label: Classical monocytes (S100A8/9-high)
reference.evidence: S100A9 (0.79), S100A8 (0.85), S100A12 (0.87), LYZ (0.57), VCAN, CD14, MNDA, PLBD1, CES1, QPCT. FCGR3A absent; neutrophil markers FCGR3B, CXCR2, MPO, ELANE essentially absent.

reference.label: Naive B cells
reference.evidence: IGHM (0.97), IGHD (0.93), FCER2 (0.97), TCL1A (0.86), FCRL1, PAX5, CD22, MS4A1, CD79A/B, CD19, CXCR5, IL4R. IGHG1/IGHA1/CD27 zero and plasma markers XBP1/PRDM1/SDC1 absent (JCHAIN/MZB1 low).

reference.label: CD56dim NK cells
reference.evidence: GNLY, NKG7, PRF1, GZMB, FCGR3A (0.51), KLRF1 (0.65), SH2D1B, NCR1, S1PR5, CX3CR1, SPON2, CLIC3, TBX21. CD3E/CD3D zero and CD8A ~0, ruling out T cells; GZMK and KLRC1 low (not CD56bright).

reference.label: Naive lymphocyte program (SELL/CCR7/CXCR4)
reference.evidence: CXCR4, SELL, CCR7, FCMR, BACH2, IL4R, plus specific AKAP6 (0.87), NT5E (0.44), DDR1 (0.48), ITPR1. All lineage markers absent (MS4A1, CD79A, IGHM, CD3E, TRAC, CD4, CD8A = 0), so a lineage-agnostic naive/resting module rather than a cell type.

reference.label: Classical monocytes (CD14/KLF4/TREM1)
reference.evidence: CD14 (0.54), KLF4 (0.72), CSF3R (0.70), SLC11A1 (0.70), TREM1 (0.77), CREB5, OSCAR, HK3, C5AR1, VCAN, CEBPD, plus FOS/DUSP1. FCGR3A zero; neutrophil markers FCGR3B, CXCR2, CEACAM8 absent.

reference.label: Immediate early genes (FOS/JUN)
reference.evidence: Compact factor (~300 genes) dominated by FOS (16%), JUN, DUSP1, FOSB, IER2, CD69, NR4A2, PPP1R15A, ZFP36, with CXCR4/TSC22D3/TXNIP; classic IEG/dissociation response.

reference.label: ACTB/VIM/S100A4-high
reference.evidence: Top genes ACTB, VIM, TMSB4X, S100A4, B2M, LGALS1, ANXA2 are ubiquitous with specificity <=0.17; no lineage marker (CD3E, MS4A1, CD14, NKG7 all zero).

reference.label: Non-classical (CD16+) monocytes
reference.evidence: CDKN1C (1.00), LYPD2 (1.00), HES4, TCF7L2 (0.68), CSF1R (0.66), MS4A7 (0.59), HMOX1, LST1, LILRB2, SIGLEC10, FCGR3A (0.33).

reference.label: TXNIP/KLF2 quiescence program
reference.evidence: TXNIP (9.2%, spec 0.28), KLF2, TSC22D3, BTG1, ZFP36L2, PIK3IP1, KLF9, DDIT4, PER1, FKBP5, ZBTB16 — quiescence/glucocorticoid-responsive genes, all low specificity; no lineage markers.

reference.label: CD4 memory T cells (Th1-like)
reference.evidence: IL32, TRAC, CD2, CD5, CD6, THEMIS, MAF, CXCR3 (0.42), PRDM1, SLAMF1, IL7R, CD4, CD40LG. CD8A, FOXP3, CCR7 and SELL zero (memory, non-Treg).

reference.label: ACTB/TMSB4X/PFN1 cytoskeletal
reference.evidence: ACTB, TMSB4X, B2M, PFN1, ACTG1, LCP1, CORO1A, CFL1 with specificity <=0.08 throughout; lineage markers zero.

reference.label: Mitochondrial genes
reference.evidence: MT-CO3, MT-ATP6, MT-CO2, MT-ND4, MT-ND3, MT-CYB, MT-ND4L etc. account for ~55% of weight (spec ~0.4-0.5); nuclear OXPHOS genes not enriched.

reference.label: TXNIP/B2M-high
overreach: MHC class I / antigen presentation program
reference.evidence: TXNIP (0.22), B2M (0.18), PNRC1, some MT genes, otherwise ubiquitous low-specificity genes; no ISGs and no lineage markers.

reference.label: CD4 memory T cells (IL7R/LTB)
reference.evidence: IL7R, LTB, TCF7, CD4, CD40LG, GATA3, MAL, TRAT1, CCR4, TNFRSF4, PI16 (0.40) and specific ADAM23/MYO16/NEFL (~0.9). CD8A, FOXP3 zero; CCR7/SELL zero argue against naive.

reference.label: VIM/AHNAK/CRIP1-high
reference.evidence: VIM (0.39), AHNAK, CRIP1 (0.42), LMNA (0.53), MYADM, S100A10, ANXA1, LGALS1, ANXA2 — a memory/effector-associated cytoskeletal module, but all lineage markers (CD3E, IL7R, CD14, MS4A1, NKG7) are zero.

reference.label: Plasmacytoid dendritic cells
reference.evidence: CLEC4C (1.00), LILRA4, IL3RA, PTPRS (0.95), SERPINF1, LAMP5, SCT, TNFRSF21, PLD4, IRF7/IRF8, TCF4. JCHAIN/MZB1 are known pDC genes; MS4A1/CD79A not here.

reference.label: Immediate early genes (JUNB)
reference.evidence: Dominated by JUNB (17.5%, spec 0.53) with IER2, BTG2, CD69, NR4A2, DUSP2, TNFAIP3, CSRNP1, SOCS3; no lineage specificity.

reference.label: TXNIP/ACTB/VIM-high
reference.evidence: TXNIP, ACTB, VIM, TMSB10, CORO1A, PFN1 with specificity <=0.11; CD3E, CCR7, SELL, NKG7 all zero.

reference.label: T cells (TRBC2-expressing)
reference.evidence: TRBC2 dominates (21%, spec 0.90) with TRAC, CD3D/E/G, ITM2A; complements metagene 42 (TRBC1). Neither CD4 nor CD8A is enriched.

reference.label: B2M-high diffuse
reference.evidence: B2M (0.11), TXNIP, LAPTM5, JUNB, LTB, UCP2 and OXPHOS/translation genes all with specificity <0.12; no lineage markers.

reference.label: Immediate early genes (EGR1)
reference.evidence: Very compact (~100 genes): EGR1 (26.6%, spec 0.99), JUN, FOSB, IER2, BTG2, DUSP2, NR4A1, EGR2/EGR3 (~0.65).

reference.label: CXCR4/ACTB/TSC22D3-high
reference.evidence: CXCR4, ACTB, TSC22D3, JUND, CORO1A, CD69 with specificity <=0.18; lineage markers zero.

reference.label: TMSB4X/IL7R/TCF7 diffuse
reference.evidence: TMSB4X, TXNIP, IL7R, JUNB, TCF7, NELL2 but every gene has specificity <=0.06 (0.39% usage); CD3E, CD4, CD8A, CCR7 zero.

reference.label: B2M/CXCR4/BTG1 diffuse
reference.evidence: B2M, CXCR4, VIM, BTG1, PNRC1, EEF1G, translation/OXPHOS genes, specificity <=0.11 throughout (~2900 effective genes).

reference.label: TMSB4X/BTG1/PNRC1 diffuse
reference.evidence: TMSB4X, BTG1, PNRC1, DUSP1, TSC22D3, KLF6 with specificity <=0.12; no lineage markers.

reference.label: CD8 effector memory/TEMRA T cells
reference.evidence: NKG7, GNLY, CCL5, GZMH (0.40), CD8A (0.20), CD3E, ZNF683, KLRG1, CX3CR1, FCRL6, TBX21. GZMK zero; NK-specific NCR1/KLRF1 ~0; CD4 zero.

reference.label: Immediate early genes (FOS)
reference.evidence: FOS alone is ~40% of weight (spec 0.50) plus JUNB, KLF2, TSC22D3; compact (~140 genes).

reference.label: Diffuse housekeeping (TMSB4X/DDX5)
reference.evidence: ~3000 effective genes, all specificity <0.13 (TMSB4X, TXNIP, MT genes, DDX5, AKNA, ARGLU1); no lineage markers.

reference.label: MAIT cells
reference.evidence: SLC4A10 (1.00), RORC (0.99), IL23R (1.00), KLRB1 (0.58), ZBTB16, CCR6, IL18RAP, CXCR6, ME1, LTK, IL7R, CD3E. TRDC ~0 and CD4 zero.

reference.label: CCR4+ CD4 memory T cells
reference.evidence: CCR4 (0.57), CCR10 (0.50), FUT7, CD4, CD5, CD28, MAF, AQP3, GATA3, ICOS, PI16. FOXP3 and CD8A zero; CCR7 ~0.

reference.label: Platelets
reference.evidence: PPBP, PF4, CAVIN2, TUBB1, ITGB3, ITGA2B, GP1BB, GP9, NRGN, TREML1 — many at specificity ~1.0.

reference.label: SPOCK2/BCL11B diffuse T
reference.evidence: KLF2, SPOCK2, FYB1, BCL11B, CD2, CD3E but specificity <=0.14 throughout (~2760 effective genes); no subtype markers.

reference.label: JUN/NFKBIA stress response
reference.evidence: JUN (0.24), NFKBIA, IER5, PPP1R15A, IRF1, SQSTM1, PIM3, NFKBIE; IL1B/CXCL8 absent and lineage markers zero.

reference.label: CD56bright NK cells
reference.evidence: GNLY, IL2RB, KLRC1 (0.62), NCAM1 (0.43), XCL1 (0.92), XCL2, SELL, TCF7, IL18RAP, SPTSSB. FCGR3A zero, CD3E/CD8A ~0, KIT low.

reference.label: ACTB/LCP1 cytoskeletal diffuse
reference.evidence: ACTB, TMSB4X, LCP1, KLF2, ACTG1, PFN1, CORO1A with specificity <=0.14; lineage markers zero.

reference.label: KLF2/TMSB4X diffuse
reference.evidence: KLF2 (0.11), TMSB4X, CORO1A, LSP1, RAC2; weak ribosome-biogenesis tail (SRM, NOP16, MYBBP1A) with spec ~0.1; no lineage markers.

reference.label: AKNA/ZAP70 lymphocyte diffuse
reference.evidence: AKNA, ARHGEF1, IKZF1, TMC8, ZAP70, ITGAL with specificity <=0.15; CD3E, NKG7 zero.

reference.label: ARHGEF1/CORO1A diffuse
reference.evidence: TMSB4X, ARHGEF1, CORO1A, LENG8, LSP1, AKNA with specificity <=0.06 throughout; no lineage markers.

reference.label: Regulatory T cells
reference.evidence: FOXP3 (1.00), RTKN2 (0.91), IL2RA (0.61), CTLA4 (0.55), IKZF2, TIGIT, LINC02694, DUSP4, CCR4.

reference.label: FOS/FTH1-high
reference.evidence: FOS (9%, spec 0.11), FTH1 (0.26), DUSP1, VIM, LAPTM5, lysosomal CTSB/NPC2 at low specificity; CD14, CD68, CSF1R and other lineage markers zero.

reference.label: Immediate early genes (IER2/ZFP36/NR4A1)
reference.evidence: IER2 (0.20), ZFP36 (0.22), BTG2, NR4A1 (0.28), IER5, PIM3, PPP1R15A; lineage markers (CD14, CD1C, MS4A1, CD3E) zero.

reference.label: T cells (TRBC1-expressing)
reference.evidence: TRBC1 dominates (11.9%, spec 0.98) with TRAC, CD3D/E/G, ITM2A, LCK; mirror of TRBC2 metagene 19.

reference.label: PTGDS/S100B CD57+ cytotoxic lymphocytes
reference.evidence: PTGDS (0.93), S100B (0.91), FGFBP2, SPON2, MYOM2, ZNF683 (0.69), B3GAT1/CD57 (0.66), GZMH, PRSS23. CD3E/CD8A zero yet NK markers KLRF1, NCR1, SH2D1B, FCER1G also zero, so lineage (NK vs CD8 TEMRA) is unresolved.

reference.label: IER2/KLF2 diffuse
reference.evidence: IER2 (0.18) then ~2500 effective genes at specificity <=0.06 (KLF2, RSRP1, CELF2, IKZF1); no lineage markers.

reference.label: ITGA4/CRIP1/CD52 diffuse
reference.evidence: CD74, LAPTM5, ITGA4, CRIP1, CD52 with specificity <=0.10; CDCA7 (0.35) tiny weight; MKI67/TOP2A belong to metagene 93 not here; lineage markers zero.

reference.label: Classical monocytes (S100A8/9-low)
reference.evidence: LYZ, CD74, IFI30, CTSS, CD14, CPVL (0.42), LGALS2, TMEM176B, CD300E, MS4A6A, MARCO. S100A8/S100A9 zero; FCGR3A, CD1C, FCER1A, CLEC10A, C1QA zero.

reference.label: ZFP36L2/DDIT4 diffuse
reference.evidence: ZFP36L2 (0.16), TSC22D3, DDIT4, then ~2700 effective genes at specificity <=0.08 (weak nucleolar tail NOP16/RRS1/NOP2); no lineage markers.

reference.label: GZMK+ CD8 T cells
reference.evidence: GZMK (0.89), CCL5, CD8A (0.32), EOMES, GZMA, CCR5, LAG3, SH2D1A, CD3E. GZMB zero, CCR7/SELL zero, KLRB1/NCR1/KLRF1 zero.

reference.label: CRIP1/AHNAK/ANXA1-high
reference.evidence: CRIP1, AHNAK, ANXA1, KLF6, TAGAP, MYADM, PBXIP1, ATP2B1 at specificity <=0.23; T/NK/myeloid lineage markers zero.

reference.label: Class-switched memory B cells
reference.evidence: B cell genes (MS4A1, CD79A/B, BANK1, BLK, PAX5, CD22) with specific switched isotypes IGHA1 (0.88), IGHA2 (0.93), IGHG1 (0.67) and memory-associated TNFRSF13B/TACI (0.72), AIM2 (0.63). IGHM, IGHD and TCL1A have zero weight (not naive); plasma markers MZB1, XBP1, PRDM1, SDC1 are negligible.

reference.label: BTG1/mitochondrial-high (diffuse)
reference.evidence: Diffuse factor (large effective gene number) with near-zero specificity throughout (~3000 genes); top genes are BTG1 (spec 0.10), MT-ND/MT-ATP6 genes (spec 0.03-0.14) and generic housekeeping/splicing genes (TXNIP, MBNL1, LUC7L3); no lineage markers with specificity.

reference.label: Naive CD4 T cells
reference.evidence: TCF7, CCR7 (0.17), LEF1, SATB1, SELL, IL7R, BCL11B, CD4 and naive-CD4 genes NOG (0.30), EDAR, ANKRD55, CD28; CD8A, GZMK, CCL5, NKG7, FOXP3 absent. Specificities are modest (diffuse among several naive T factors).

reference.label: Atypical (age-associated) B cells
reference.evidence: B genes (MS4A1, CD79A, CD19, CD22, CD72) with atypical/ABC markers FCRL5 (0.49), FCRL3, FCRL2, SOX5 (0.93), ZEB2, FGR, HCK, ITGAX and TBX21 (weak), ZBTB32, SIGLEC6, IGHG3 (0.92); CR2/CD21, CD27, TCL1A, FCER2 absent. Plasma markers MZB1, PRDM1, XBP1 absent.

reference.label: IL32/TCF7-high T cells (diffuse)
reference.evidence: Top genes IL32, TCF7, ZFP36L2 plus mitochondrial genes with low specificity (<0.13 throughout, ~2500 genes). Some T genes (LEF1, MAL, BCL11B, CAMK4, FLT3LG) but CD4, CD8A, CCR7, SELL all zero; no clear subtype.

reference.label: Immediate early genes (FOSB)
reference.evidence: Dominated by FOSB (21% weight, spec 0.67) with MCL1, DUSP1, JUND, JUNB, ZFP36, PPP1R15A, NR4A2, KLF6, TSC22D3; low gene number (253). Not lineage-restricted (CD3E, MS4A1, CD14 zero); heat shock genes negligible.

reference.label: Naive CD4 T cells
reference.evidence: TCF7, LEF1, IL7R, CCR7, SATB1, CD4, CD28, CD5, CD6, NELL2, TSHZ2, CACNA1I, WNT7A, TNFRSF25, SESN3; CD8A, GZMK, CCL5, FOXP3 absent. Specificities low (<0.2), one of several overlapping naive T factors.

reference.label: Type I interferon response
reference.evidence: Classic ISGs with high specificity: IFI44L (1.00), IFIT1 (1.00), IFI44 (0.93), IFIT3 (0.90), RSAD2, CMPK2, OAS3, OAS1/2, MX1/MX2, ISG15, IFI6, XAF1, IFI27, USP18, HERC5. GBP1/IRF1-dominant IFN-gamma genes are in metagene 99 instead.

reference.label: Nuclear/long transcript genes (diffuse)
reference.evidence: Diffuse factor (large effective gene number) with near-zero specificity throughout (~2600 genes): MT-CO3, BTG1, MCL1 and nuclear/splicing-associated transcripts (LENG8, ARGLU1, LUC7L3, PNISR, SRRM2, SF3B1) with specificities <0.1; no lineage or state markers.

reference.label: Activated memory CD4 T cells
reference.evidence: T genes (TCF7, TRAC, CD5, CD6, ZAP70, ITK) with CD4, CD40LG, ICOS, TIGIT, CD28, GPR174, CXCR5 (0.11), ST8SIA1 (0.60), CD69, TRAF1, BIRC3; CCR7/SELL/LEF1 weak and FOXP3, CTLA4, CD8A absent. Tfh markers PDCD1, CXCL13, BCL6 are weak or absent, so Tfh is not established.

reference.label: EVL/long-gene lymphocyte (diffuse)
reference.evidence: Diffuse factor (large effective gene number) with near-zero specificity throughout (~2800 genes): EVL (0.11) then generic long/nuclear genes (PNRC1, CELF2, OGT, CHD2, RESF1, ATM) with specificities <0.06.

reference.label: T cell markers
reference.evidence: TRAC (3.8%, spec 0.22), CD3D/CD3G (0.14), CD3E, CD2, CD7, CD27, GIMAP4/7, IL32, LDHB, CD5, SIT1; no CD4/CD8 bias in top genes. Also heavy in generic B2M/TMSB4X/ACTB.

reference.label: PNRC1-high diffuse
reference.evidence: Diffuse factor (large effective gene number) with near-zero specificity throughout (~3000 genes): PNRC1, EEF2, CHD2, ARRDC3, ITGA4, OGT with all specificities <=0.07.

reference.label: Linker histone H1-10/H1-2
reference.evidence: Dominated by H1-10 (8% weight, spec 0.77) with H1-2, H1-3, H1-4 (spec 0.15-0.20); rest is low-specificity nuclear transcripts. Proliferation markers (MKI67, MCMs, TOP2A) absent; these are in metagene 93. Biological meaning unclear.

reference.label: Naive CD4 T cells
reference.evidence: TCF7, BCL11B, SATB1, CCR7, LEF1, SELL, CD7, CD3E, CD4, CD5, CD6, THEMIS, LAT, NOG and naive-associated TCEA3, EPHA1, DPYSL4; CD8A, GZMK, CCL5 absent. Low specificities; overlaps other naive T factors.

reference.label: JUND/mito-high diffuse
reference.evidence: Diffuse factor (large effective gene number) with near-zero specificity throughout (~2900 genes): JUND, MT-ND1, MBNL1, H1-4, UBC, PPIA, PSME1/2 with specificities <=0.26; no coherent theme.

reference.label: Naive CD4 T cells
reference.evidence: IL7R, LTB, TCF7, LEF1, SATB1, SELL, CCR7 (0.13), MAL, TRAT1, CD4, CD28, CD40LG and naive genes LRRN3 (0.40), NOG, ANKRD55, FHIT; CD8A, GZMK, CCL5, NKG7 absent.

reference.label: Cytokine/STAT5 signaling in naive T
reference.evidence: STAT5 targets MYC, PIM1, PIM2, CISH, SOCS3, SOCS2, BCL2 on a naive T background (LEF1, TRAT1, MAL, SATB1, ITK) plus naive-associated DACT1 (0.71), ADTRP, EDA, FHIT. Shares CISH/PIM1 with metagene 84; FOXP3, CD8A absent and IL2RA weak.

candidates.c2: T cell survival and signaling module

reference.label: EVL/EEF2 T cell (diffuse)
reference.evidence: Diffuse factor (large effective gene number) with near-zero specificity throughout (~2400 genes): MT-CO2, EVL, EEF2, MLLT6, NOP53 with some T signaling genes (ZAP70, ITPKB, CARMIL2, OBSCN, JAK3) all at specificity <=0.12.

reference.label: Naive CD8 T cells
reference.evidence: CD8A (0.25), CD8B2 (0.54), NELL2 (0.34), CCR7, LEF1, TCF7, SELL, IL7R, plus naive-CD8 specific CD248 (1.00), LRRN3, NRCAM, SFRP5; CD4 zero and cytotoxic genes GZMK, GZMB, NKG7, CCL5 absent.

reference.label: Mitochondrial genes
reference.evidence: Top weights are MT-CO2, MT-CO3, MT-ATP6, MT-ND1-6, MT-CYB (together >10%), with FXYD5, ETS1, PNRC1; all specificities low (<0.13), more mito-dominated than any lineage.

reference.label: SELL/CD52/translation-high (diffuse)
reference.evidence: SELL (2.4%, spec 0.23), H1-10, CD52, LAPTM5 plus translation/OXPHOS housekeeping genes (EEF2, EEF1G, EIF3, COX genes) at low specificity; lineage markers CD3E, MS4A1, CD79A, CCR7, NKG7 are all zero.

reference.label: CD52/B2M low-specificity background
reference.evidence: Low usage (0.19%), ~2300 genes with specificity ~0.01 for every top gene (CD52, B2M, TMSB4X, OAZ1). Trace HBB (0.61), SLC4A1, ALAS2 have tiny weights (<0.1%), so erythrocyte identity is not supported; platelet genes PPBP, PF4 absent.

reference.label: JUND/KLF2-high lymphocyte (diffuse)
reference.evidence: Diffuse factor (large effective gene number) with near-zero specificity throughout (~2000 genes): JUND (0.11), TSC22D3, KLF2, SELL, RSRP1, LENG8 with specificities <=0.14; IEG FOS/EGR1 not prominent and glucocorticoid targets FKBP5, ZBTB16 absent.

reference.label: Cytotoxic CD8 T cells
reference.evidence: NKG7, CTSW, CST7, CCL5, KLRK1, KLRD1, KLRG1, CD8A (0.19), TIGIT, FCRL6, KLRC3/4, EOMES, TBX21, PRF1, GZMM, IL2RB. CD3E present modestly; NCAM1 zero and KLRF1/NCR1/FCGR3A weak, so not NK; GZMB, GNLY, FGFBP2 absent and GZMK absent.

reference.label: Naive CD4 T cells
reference.evidence: LTB, TRAC, IL7R, MAL, CCR7, LEF1, BCL11B, CD4 (0.04) with naive-CD4-associated FHIT (0.28), EDA (0.42), TSHZ2, INPP4B, ADTRP, CACNA1I, TCEA3; CD8A absent, SELL zero. Low specificities overall.

reference.label: ITGA4/SUN2 lymphocyte (diffuse)
reference.evidence: Diffuse factor (large effective gene number) with near-zero specificity throughout (~2000 genes): MT-ATP6, ITGA4 (0.10), SUN2, LSP1, CD52, TNFAIP3 with specificities <=0.10.

reference.label: Conventional dendritic cells type 2
reference.evidence: Antigen-presentation genes CD74, LYZ, CST3, HLA/CIITA with cDC2-specific CLEC10A (0.99), FCER1A (0.45), CD1C, LGALS2, CPVL, ZNF366, ENHO, FPR3, CD1D. CD14, S100A8, FCGR3A zero (not monocytes); LILRA4, IL3RA absent (not pDC); CLEC9A/XCR1 trace only.

reference.label: EEF2/translation lymphocyte (diffuse)
reference.evidence: Diffuse factor (large effective gene number) with near-zero specificity throughout (~2700 genes): EEF2, EEF1G, TMSB4X/10, EVL, UBA52, NOP53 at specificity <=0.07.

reference.label: Naive/central memory CD4 T cells
reference.evidence: IL7R (0.16), SELL (0.14), GIMAP7/4/5/1/2, TCF7, CCR7, CD4, CD3E, GPR183, CD40LG, AQP3, CD28, CD27, LEF1; CD8A, GZMK, CCL5, FOXP3 absent.

reference.label: NF-kB signaling
reference.evidence: NFKBIA (2.75%, 0.25), NFKB2 (0.26), RELB (0.35), BCL3, IER5, BIRC3, REL, TNIP1, TNFAIP3, ZC3H12A, CD83, NFKBIE, NFKBID, TRAF3/4; lineage markers CD3E, MS4A1, CD14 zero, and myeloid cytokines (CCL3, IL1B) belong to metagene 98.

reference.label: KLF6/LCP1 lymphocyte (diffuse)
reference.evidence: Diffuse factor (large effective gene number) with near-zero specificity throughout (~2900 genes): KLF6, LCP1, ACTB, CYTIP with specificities <=0.08; weak nucleolar genes (MYBBP1A, NOP16, GNL3) only.

reference.label: Mitochondrial genes
reference.evidence: MT-ND4 5.5%, MT-CO3 5.3%, MT-ATP6, MT-ND3, MT-CO2, MT-CYB, MT-ND4L, MT-ND5, MT-ND2 (spec 0.10-0.23), >30% of weight; remaining genes are generic lymphocyte transcripts.

reference.label: CORO1A/ARHGEF1 T cell cytoskeleton (diffuse)
reference.evidence: Diffuse factor (large effective gene number) with near-zero specificity throughout (~2350 genes): CORO1A (0.09), ARHGEF1, SPN, CNN2, DOK2, LAT, LCK, SH3BP1 at specificities <=0.10.

reference.label: STAT5/IL-2 cytokine signaling
reference.evidence: STAT5 targets PIM1 (3.9%, 0.50), CISH (0.82), BCL2 (0.36), PIM2, SOCS2 (0.39), SOCS1, BCL2L1, PTGER2, CDK6, UPP1 on a T background (IL32, ITK, GIMAP4/7). FOXP3 zero and IL2RA absent; XBP1 trace.

reference.label: Hematopoietic stem/progenitor cells
reference.evidence: Specific progenitor markers CD34 (1.00), SPINK2 (0.95), MEX3B, HOXA9, MEIS1, GATA2, CRHBP, KIT, PRSS57, CYTL1, SOX4, NREP, MYB, CDK6; some mast/eos-lineage priming (PRG2, CLC). MKI67, ELANE, PF4, PPBP, HBB absent.

reference.label: Memory CD4 T cells (LTB/MAF)
reference.evidence: LTB (5.2%, 0.25), MAF (0.25), CD28, CD4, AQP3, TNFRSF25, INPP4B (0.38), NPDC1, CTLA4 (0.24), ICOS, GPR15, CD27. FOXP3 zero (in metagene 39) and IL2RA weak, so not Tregs; RORC, KLRB1 absent and CCR6 weak, so not Th17.

reference.label: Y-linked genes with LSP1/IRF1
reference.evidence: Diffuse (~2100 genes) with LSP1, OAZ1, ADGRE5, IRF1, NLRC5, but includes Y-linked UTY, KDM5D, DDX3Y, USP9Y, EIF1AY (spec ~0.2) among the top genes, suggesting a donor/batch component (main Y factor is 91).

reference.label: IKZF1/UCP2/BTG2-high (diffuse)
reference.evidence: IKZF1 (3.2%, 0.19), UCP2 (0.25), BTG2 (0.13), ARHGDIB, RAC2 then generic lymphocyte genes at specificities <0.1; no lineage markers (CD3E, MS4A1, NKG7, CD14 zero).

reference.label: Lymphocyte activation (DUSP2/FOSL2/NR4A2)
reference.evidence: DUSP2 (2.6%, 0.42), TNFAIP3, FOSL2 (0.23), NR4A2, SH2D2A, PDE4D, METRNL, ENC1, TENT5C, SLA2, DDIT4, CREM, PMAIP1, MAFF, with effector-lymphocyte genes RUNX3, STAT4, SYTL3, KLRG1. CD3E, CD8A, NKG7, GZMs zero, so cell type is unclear.

reference.label: SYNE2/KLRG1/SAMD3-high (diffuse)
reference.evidence: Diffuse factor (large effective gene number) with near-zero specificity throughout (~2400 genes): SYNE2, KLRG1 (0.16), SAMD3, PLAC8, TC2N, SYTL2, STAT4, TRGC1 hint at effector/memory lymphocytes, but CD8A, NKG7, GZMs, NCAM1 are all zero.

reference.label: Y chromosome genes
reference.evidence: Y-linked UTY, DDX3Y, KDM5D, USP9Y, EIF1AY (all spec 0.75), ZFY (0.74), TMSB4Y, PRKY, with low-specificity lymphocyte background genes.

reference.label: B2M/RAC2 lymphocyte (diffuse)
reference.evidence: Diffuse factor (large effective gene number) with near-zero specificity throughout (~2600 genes): B2M, RAC2, TMSB4X, TXNIP, ARHGEF1 with specificities <=0.06.

reference.label: Cell cycle (S phase)
reference.evidence: Histones H1-5 (1.00), H1-2/3, H2BC9 and replication genes MCM2-7, E2F1 (0.83), FANCA, HELLS, TCF19, PCNA, TYMS, TK1, RRM2, UHRF1, CDT1, DTL, PCLAF, plus MKI67 (1.00), TOP2A, CDK1. Lineage markers CD3E, MS4A1, NKG7 zero.

reference.label: MAF/GIMAP/KLF3 lymphocyte (diffuse)
reference.evidence: Diffuse factor (large effective gene number) with near-zero specificity throughout (~1900 genes): TMSB4X, EVL, PFN1, CORO1A, GIMAP4/7, MAF (0.14), KLF3, RORA, GBP5; CD4, CD8A, CD3E essentially absent, so no subtype.

reference.label: BTG2/SOCS3-high (diffuse)
reference.evidence: BTG2 (0.14), SOCS3 (0.23), CD69, NFKBIZ, DDIT4, KLF9, PER1 but all other genes low specificity (~2100 genes). Glucocorticoid targets TSC22D3, FKBP5, ZBTB16 absent; theme too weak.

reference.label: CD44/UCP2-high (diffuse)
reference.evidence: CD44 (3.2%, 0.22), UCP2 (0.15), CDC42SE1, LIMD2, H1-4 then generic genes at specificity <0.16 (~1800 genes).

reference.label: KLF2/TXNIP lymphocyte (diffuse)
reference.evidence: Diffuse factor (large effective gene number) with near-zero specificity throughout (~1700 genes): KLF2, TXNIP, ARHGEF1, IKZF1, CDC42SE1 with specificities <=0.10.

reference.label: Inflammatory myeloid activation
reference.evidence: Highly specific inflammatory genes CXCL8 (1.00), IL1B (0.99), G0S2 (1.00), CCL3 (0.85), CXCL2, CCL3L3, EREG, IL1A, TNFAIP6, PTX3, IER3, NLRP3, IL1RN, PTGS2, TNF with NFKBIA/TNFAIP3/SOD2/PLAUR. Neutrophil markers CSF3R, FCGR3B, CXCR2 zero; baseline monocyte genes (CD14, LYZ, VCAN) not loaded here.

reference.label: Interferon-gamma response
reference.evidence: IRF1 (5.8%, 0.58), STAT1 (0.66), GBP1/2/4/5, NLRC5, TAP1/2, PSMB8/9/10, APOL1/2/3/6, UBE2L6, IRF9; classic type I ISGs (IFI44L, IFIT1, MX1) are in metagene 57 instead.
